## Airbus First Quarter (Q1) 2026 financial results

At a glance

> The Q1 results reflect the lower level of commercial aircraft deliveries and a strong performance
> in our Defence and Space division. The operating environment remains dynamic and complex. We are
> closely monitoring the potential impact from the fast-changing situation in the Middle East. In
> commercial aircraft, we continue to ramp up and produce as per our plan while navigating the
> shortage of Pratt & Whitney engines.

# Amazon Leo
# LE-03

Arianespace successfully launches 36 additional Amazon Leo satellites with an Ariane 64 equipped
with advanced boosters

[ Learn more
][33]

Any mission to any orbit

Launch solutions for every mission, to every orbit

For over 40 years, Arianespace has partnered with commercial and institutional customers, offering a
versatile family of launchers that delivers satellites for telecommunications, navigation, Earth
observation, scientific research and technology demonstrations.

[ DISCOVER OUR SOLUTIONS
][34]

launch services

## We are
## the experts
## in launch services

Arianespace dedicates all of its expertise to fulfilling its customers’ space ambitions. With
flexible launch solutions and personalized support, our experts ensure your missions are a success,
making each project a unique, memorable adventure.

[ Discover our launch services
][35]

ARIANE 6

## The perfect launch vehicle for all your missions and orbit requirements

Ariane 6

862TTypical lift-off mass

Discover Ariane 6, the new-generation heavy launcher that combines reliability, versatility, and
performance, operated by Arianespace. This launcher is designed to efficiently meet the diverse
needs of our customers. With its advanced technical capabilities and enhanced performance, Ariane 6
offers an optimal solution for a wide range of space missions.

[ Discover Ariane 6
][36]

Ground services experts

## We are the experts
## in ground services

Arianespace relies on the expertise of its teams to orchestrate each launch with precision and
rigor. From logistics to the meticulous preparation of satellites, every stage is carefully managed
to ensure the success of our customers' missions and to meet the highest standards of the space
industry.

[ Discover our ground services
][37]

## the experts
## in launch services

flexible launch solutions and personalized support, our experts ensure your missions are a success,

[ Discover our launch services

ARIANE 6

## The perfect launch vehicle for all your missions and orbit requirements

Ariane 6

862TTypical lift-off mass

Discover Ariane 6, the new-generation heavy launcher that combines reliability, versatility, and
performance, operated by Arianespace. This launcher is designed to efficiently meet the diverse
needs of our customers. With its advanced technical capabilities and enhanced performance, Ariane 6
offers an optimal solution for a wide range of space missions.

[ Discover Ariane 6

## in ground services

Arianespace relies on the expertise of its teams to orchestrate each launch with precision and
rigor. From logistics to the meticulous preparation of satellites, every stage is carefully managed
to ensure the success of our customers' missions and to meet the highest standards of the space
industry.

# Terrestrial Landers

Reusable vehicles with the most rocket-powered landings in the industry.

[Test Your Payload][12]

## World Experts in VTVL

Masten has demonstrated more than 600 successful flight operations across five vertical takeoff and
vertical landing vehicles. These reusable rockets help mature precision landing systems, conduct
plume-surface interaction tests, and validate next-generation space technologies for NASA, defense,
and commercial customers. The test flights we conduct retire risk and advance technology readiness
for missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.

## Xogdor

Currently under development, Xogdor is Masten’s 6th-generation vertical takeoff and vertical landing
vehicle and our most advanced rocket yet! Powered by a 6,000 lbf turbopump-fed liquid oxygen/liquid
methane engine, Xogdor will test entry, descent, and landing systems and other space technologies to
enable precision landings on the Moon and Mars. The vehicle offers more advanced payload
accommodations, is capable of supersonic speeds, and can also be used for point-to-point payload
transportation. 

## Xodiac

Xodiac is Masten’s 5th-generation vehicle in our line of terrestrial landers with 100+ successful
flights. Xodiac has been in service since 2015 and routinely flies payloads on suborbital
trajectories to reduce risk and provide truth data to technology developers. Precision landing and
hazard avoidance technologies are routine beneficiaries of Xodiac’s flight tests. Xodiac takes off
and lands vertically, is fully reusable, and can fly multiple times a day supported by a small,
agile team.

## Xombie

Xombie is the oldest vehicle in Masten’s fleet of terrestrial landers. It first flew in 2009 and now
holds the world record with 227 rocket-powered VTVL flights. Xombie is currently in semi-retirement
with Xodiac taking most of the terrestrial flight load, but Xombies never really die… you may see
Xombie rise again.

## Other Vehicles

Xoie, Xaero, and Xaero-B are other terrestrial vehicles from our family of reusable rockets. Xoie
won the NASA-funded Northrop Grumman Lunar Lander Challenge in 2009, expending the same ∆V as a
rocket descending to the lunar surface from lunar orbit and demonstrating reusability. Xaero and
Xaero-B were used to demonstrate higher altitude flight operations that informed Masten’s ConOps for
small, agile launch teams.

# Terrestrial Landers

Reusable vehicles with the most rocket-powered landings in the industry.

[Test Your Payload][12]

## World Experts in VTVL

Masten has demonstrated more than 600 successful flight operations across five vertical takeoff and
vertical landing vehicles. These reusable rockets help mature precision landing systems, conduct
plume-surface interaction tests, and validate next-generation space technologies for NASA, defense,
and commercial customers. The test flights we conduct retire risk and advance technology readiness
for missions to the Moon, Mars, and beyond.

## Xogdor

Currently under development, Xogdor is Masten’s 6th-generation vertical takeoff and vertical landing
vehicle and our most advanced rocket yet! Powered by a 6,000 lbf turbopump-fed liquid oxygen/liquid
methane engine, Xogdor will test entry, descent, and landing systems and other space technologies to
enable precision landings on the Moon and Mars. The vehicle offers more advanced payload
accommodations, is capable of supersonic speeds, and can also be used for point-to-point payload
transportation. 

## Xodiac

Xodiac is Masten’s 5th-generation vehicle in our line of terrestrial landers with 100+ successful
flights. Xodiac has been in service since 2015 and routinely flies payloads on suborbital
trajectories to reduce risk and provide truth data to technology developers. Precision landing and
hazard avoidance technologies are routine beneficiaries of Xodiac’s flight tests. Xodiac takes off
and lands vertically, is fully reusable, and can fly multiple times a day supported by a small,
agile team.

## Xombie

Xombie is the oldest vehicle in Masten’s fleet of terrestrial landers. It first flew in 2009 and now
holds the world record with 227 rocket-powered VTVL flights. Xombie is currently in semi-retirement
with Xodiac taking most of the terrestrial flight load, but Xombies never really die… you may see
Xombie rise again.

## Other Vehicles

Xoie, Xaero, and Xaero-B are other terrestrial vehicles from our family of reusable rockets. Xoie
won the NASA-funded Northrop Grumman Lunar Lander Challenge in 2009, expending the same ∆V as a
rocket descending to the lunar surface from lunar orbit and demonstrating reusability. Xaero and
Xaero-B were used to demonstrate higher altitude flight operations that informed Masten’s ConOps for
small, agile launch teams.

## Solutions

for a range of mission profiles. Photon, Pioneer,

solutions also span mission simulation and ground
software solutions that provide complete spacecraft
command and control for all spacecraft
and constellations.

subsystems and components that

## From Idea
## To Orbit

Rocket Lab is an end-to-end space
company delivering reliable launch
services, complete spacecraft design
and manufacturing, satellite components,
flight software, and more.
[About Us][65]

## Dedicated
## Small Launch

Electron is the second most frequently launched U.S.
rocket, delivering mission success for commercial
and government satellite operators.

Offering dedicated and rideshare options, tailored
orbits, schedule control and responsive launch.
We deliver your mission, your way.
[More][66]

## Hypersonic
## Suborbital

HASTE is a suborbital testbed launch vehicle
derived from Rocket Lab's heritage rocket
[More][67]

## Medium
## Launch

Neutron, our 13-tonne payload class
launch vehicle in development. Reliable
and cost-effective launch services for
constellation deployment, cargo
resupply, and interplanetary missions.
[More][68]

## Spacecraft
## Solutions

A family of advanced configurable spacecraft
for a range of mission profiles. Photon, Pioneer,
Lightning, Explorer.
[More][69]

## World Leading
## Space Solar

Highest efficiency space solar cells and CICs
providing power to over 1000 spacecraft.
[More][70]

## Flight & Ground
## Software

Industry-leading off-the-shelf flight software that has
been operating across more than 50 spacecraft for
a cumulative 150 years in space. Our expertise and
solutions also span mission simulation and ground
software solutions that provide complete spacecraft
command and control for all spacecraft
and constellations.
[More][71]

## Satellite
## Components

Reliable, flight proven satellite
subsystems and components that
make your mission possible.
[Star Trackers][72] [Separation Systems][73] [Satellite Radios][74] [Reaction Wheels][75]

## Responsive
## Space

Accelerating the path to orbit with
rapid call-up launch on demand
and agile satellite solutions.
[More][76]

### Who We Are

ARCTOS FX LLC (“ARCTOS”) is registered as a Commodity Trading Advisor (CTA) (NFA ID# 0410898).
Founded by Akhilesh S. Ganti, ARCTOS uses a systematic-based approach with a discretionary overlay
to trade the highly liquid currency market.

ARCTOS currently offers investors the opportunity to enhance their portfolios by participating in
our managed currency program. Clients of ARCTOS will transact with a counterparty whose pricing
structure is derived from inter-bank market rates. More information can be found in ARCTOS’s
disclosure document.

[ Learn More ][15]

## Precision in Every Trade

ARCTOS FX combines systematic trading methodologies with expert discretionary judgment to navigate
global currency markets.

### Systematic
### Approach

Data-driven strategies with discretionary overlay to optimize decision-making.

### Currency
### Expertise

Focus on the highly liquid forex market with counterparties using inter-bank derived pricing
structures.

### NFA
### Registered

Registered Commodity Trading Advisor (CTA - NFA ID# 0410898) ensuring compliance with regulatory
standards.

### Portfolio
### Enhancement

Strategic currency exposure designed to complement and diversify your investment portfolio.

> ##### **We do not predict trends but do try to take advantage of such an occurrence once we have
> ##### confirmation of its existence.**

### Dynamic Markets

Markets continuously adapt to stimuli, creating opportunities when expectations shift dramatically.

### Trend Participation

We let the market dictate our investing thesis rather than predicting where markets will go.

### Risk Management

Strict adherence to prudent risk management techniques to safeguard investor portfolio against
adverse market fluctuations.

## Our Plan

A systematic framework built on the belief that prices eventually reflect all relevant information.

### Absolute Return Strategies

We employ absolute return strategies that are not correlated with major indices or asset classes.
Our goal is to achieve consistent capital appreciation over a long-term investment horizon.

### Risk Management

Risk management is of the utmost importance. Predetermined stop loss levels are set for each
position at its inception. We utilize a proprietary quantitative methodology to determine position
sizing to mitigate risk per trade.

### Price Analysis

The market price of any financial instrument reflects all relevant information. As such, the study
of market price is the foundation of our analytical process..

### Signal Filtering

Market price signals can be "noisy" and may have to be filtered uncover the underlying true
information.

### Systematic Models

Trade recommendations generated by models are used in the initiation of positions at specific,
predetermined price points.

### Position Management

Proprietary quantitative methodology determines optimal position sizing.

### Market Musings

Stay informed with our latest insights and analysis on currency markets, trading strategies, and
investment opportunities.

Astra's Rocket 4.0 is engineered for the demands of the modern space economy. Built on a foundation
of rapid iteration and proven performance to deliver consistent, reliable access to orbit.

## Electric Propulsion for Constellations

Backed by flight heritage and currently on orbit, Astra's satellite engines are engineered for
efficiency, reliability, and precision to maneuver, maintain orbit, and execute mission operations.

### Engine Capabilities
* Proven reliability with thousands of hours of on-orbit operation
* Compatible with xenon and krypton propellants
* Heaterless, center-mounted, instant-start cathode
* Novel magnetic lensing and magnetic circuit
* Advanced high temperature materials

### Fastest to orbit — fueled by iteration

From a garage startup to reaching orbit faster than any private company in history, Astra's journey
is defined by relentless innovation and rapid learning. View our launch timeline below, or [explore
our full history][12].

###### 2016 October

#### Astra is founded by Chris Kemp and Dr. Adam London

In a San Francisco garage, Chris Kemp and Dr. Adam London began designing Rocket 1.0, Astra's first
launch vehicle, along with it's mobile ground support system.

###### 2017 March

#### Opened Orion Test Facility in Alameda, California

At the former Alameda Naval Air Station, Astra transforms a retired jet engine test cell into a
rocket engine development site — marking the start of the first rocket construction and Astra's
first electric pump-fed engine tests.

###### 2018 July

#### Test launch, Version 1.0, LV0001

Astra's first test launch was on July 20, 2018 in Kodiak, Alaska, less than two years after being
founded. The primary goal was to collect initial flight data — successfully achieved with nearly 25
seconds of flight.

[[Rocket launching from a ground platform with smoke and flames beneath it and industrial buildings
in the background.]][13]

###### 2018 November

#### Test launch, Version 2.0, LV0002

Astra validated major upgrades to the rocket and ground system in this test. During the flight, two
engine pump controllers malfunctioned, leading to the flight's termination about 30 seconds after
liftoff.

[[Bright rocket launch at night with smoke billowing near the launch pad.]][14]

###### 2020 September

#### Test launch, Version 3.1, LV0004

Astra returned to the launch pad on September 11, 2020 with LV0004 (Rocket 3.1) and an upgraded
launcher. After lift-off, two software errors caused the rocket to veer off-course, triggering the
flight safety system to terminate the flight.

[[A rocket launching with flames and smoke billowing at the base, mountains in the background under
a cloudy sky.]][15]

###### 2020 December

#### Test launch, Version 3.2, LV0005

Successful orbital capability demonstration — On December 15, 2020, LV0005 demonstrated Astra's
orbital capability, successfully completing all flight phases and nearly reaching orbit. Building on
this breakthrough, Astra pursued a comprehensive upgrade to Rocket 3.3 with an elongated first stage
and enhanced upper stage for full orbital achievement.

###### 2021 August

#### Test Launch, Version 3.3, LV0006

On August 28, 2021, Rocket 3.3's inaugural flight successfully recovered from a single engine
shutdown before being incorrectly terminated by the Safety Officer.

Astra returned to the pad just 2 months after LV0006 and on November 19, 2021, reached orbit and

## Electric Propulsion for Constellations

Backed by flight heritage and currently on orbit, Astra's satellite engines are engineered for
efficiency, reliability, and precision to maneuver, maintain orbit, and execute mission operations.

### Engine Capabilities
* Proven reliability with thousands of hours of on-orbit operation

### Fastest to orbit — fueled by iteration

From a garage startup to reaching orbit faster than any private company in history, Astra's journey
is defined by relentless innovation and rapid learning. View our launch timeline below, or [explore
our full history][12].

###### 2016 October

#### Astra is founded by Chris Kemp and Dr. Adam London

In a San Francisco garage, Chris Kemp and Dr. Adam London began designing Rocket 1.0, Astra's first
launch vehicle, along with it's mobile ground support system.

###### 2017 March

#### Opened Orion Test Facility in Alameda, California

At the former Alameda Naval Air Station, Astra transforms a retired jet engine test cell into a
rocket engine development site — marking the start of the first rocket construction and Astra's
first electric pump-fed engine tests.

###### 2018 July

#### Test launch, Version 1.0, LV0001

Astra's first test launch was on July 20, 2018 in Kodiak, Alaska, less than two years after being
founded. The primary goal was to collect initial flight data — successfully achieved with nearly 25
seconds of flight.

[[Rocket launching from a ground platform with smoke and flames beneath it and industrial buildings
in the background.]][13]

###### 2018 November

#### Test launch, Version 2.0, LV0002

Astra validated major upgrades to the rocket and ground system in this test. During the flight, two
engine pump controllers malfunctioned, leading to the flight's termination about 30 seconds after
liftoff.

[[Bright rocket launch at night with smoke billowing near the launch pad.]][14]

###### 2020 September

#### Test launch, Version 3.1, LV0004

Astra returned to the launch pad on September 11, 2020 with LV0004 (Rocket 3.1) and an upgraded
launcher. After lift-off, two software errors caused the rocket to veer off-course, triggering the
flight safety system to terminate the flight.

[[A rocket launching with flames and smoke billowing at the base, mountains in the background under
a cloudy sky.]][15]

###### 2020 December

#### Test launch, Version 3.2, LV0005

Successful orbital capability demonstration — On December 15, 2020, LV0005 demonstrated Astra's
orbital capability, successfully completing all flight phases and nearly reaching orbit. Building on
this breakthrough, Astra pursued a comprehensive upgrade to Rocket 3.3 with an elongated first stage
and enhanced upper stage for full orbital achievement.

###### 2021 August

#### Test Launch, Version 3.3, LV0006

On August 28, 2021, Rocket 3.3's inaugural flight successfully recovered from a single engine
shutdown before being incorrectly terminated by the Safety Officer.

###### 2021 November

#### Successful Orbital Launch for the Space Force Test Program, LV0007

Astra returned to the pad just 2 months after LV0006 and on November 19, 2021, reached orbit and
delivered a test payload to orbit with a nominal flight of both first and upper stages.

###### 2022 February

#### Commercial Launch, Version 3.3, LV0008

Astra demonstrated the mobility of its launch system by transporting both the launcher and rocket to
Cape Canaveral and setting up a new launch site in less than a week. On February 10, 2022, after a
nominal first stage flight, an off-nominal payload separation occurred and Astra did not fully
deliver the 4 payloads on board.

###### 2022 March

#### Commercial Launch, Version 3.3, LV0009

Successful orbital launch for Spaceflight — On March 15, 2022, LV0009 had a 100% successful flight
for Spaceflight, delivering 22 satellites to orbit.

###### 2022 June

#### Commercial Launch, Version 3.3, LV0010

Astra's second Cape Canaveral flight completed nominal first stage operations, stage separation, and
upper stage ignition. An anomalously high fuel consumption rate in the upper stage caused the rocket
to reach only 80 percent of orbital velocity before re-entering the atmosphere.

###### 2024 October

#### Department of Defense awards Astra launch contract

Contract supports advancing and scaling the production capabilities of Astra's unique tactically
responsive launch system, to achieve the prototype objective of launching Rocket 4.0 to orbit or
suborbit and from the US, Australia, or other locations.

you don't have to check dozens of sources manually.

## Get alerts where your team already works

Receive instant alerts in Slack or Microsoft Teams, read weekly email briefings, or browse
everything in Distill's live feed.

Start tracking your market today

Set up your watchlist in minutes. Start monitoring the companies that matter to you.

## Frequently asked questions

Which companies can I track with Distill?

You can track **any company, globally**, regardless of whether they are public or private. Unlike
traditional finance tools that rely on stock ticker symbols, Distill allows you to track early-stage
startups, private companies, and niche international players just as easily as Fortune 500
companies. If the company exists and has a website, Distill can track it.

What sources does Distill track?

Distill provides a complete picture by combining **media coverage** with **official company
sources**. We monitor:
* **Major media outlets** and trusted industry news sites.
* **Local and regional news publications**.
* **Official company channels**, including press releases, blogs, and investor relations pages.
* **Medium and Substack feeds**.
* **LinkedIn company posts** to catch product launches and leadership updates often missed by the
  press.

How is Distill different from Google Alerts?

Google Alerts provides a raw list of links, often resulting in cluttered inboxes and repetitive
headlines. Distill is an **intelligence engine**. It uses AI to:
* **Group sources**: If a story is covered by 20 outlets, we group them into a single card so you
  don't read the same headline 20 times.
* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

* **Summarize insights**: We extract the key facts from both the media coverage and the official
  announcement.
* **Filter noise**: We automatically filter out low-value opinion pieces and duplicates.

Does Distill support international or non-English news?

Yes. You can track **companies in any country**. If a story breaks in a local language (e.g.,
Japanese, Swedish, or Portuguese), Distill automatically translates the article and summary into
English. This allows you to track global competitors or international markets without a language
barrier.

How does Distill prevent information overload?

We know that "more news" isn't always better. Distill gives you three layers of control to keep your
feed clean:
* **Significance filters**: You can toggle your feed to show "All News," "Notable News," or only
  "Major News" (high-impact events).
* **Topic filters**: You can set specific monitors for topics like "M&A," "Product launches," or
  "Executive changes" while ignoring the rest.
* **Source blocking**: If you dislike a specific publication, you can block it entirely from your
  feed and summaries.

Can I track an entire industry without selecting individual companies?

Yes. In addition to tracking specific company watchlists, you can follow broad **industry groups**
(e.g., Fintech, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy). You can receive weekly emails
summarizing the biggest events from that industry.

How will I receive updates? Do I need to log in daily?

You do not need to log in to stay informed. Distill delivers insights where you already work:
* **Daily recaps**: Emails listing all the latest news from the companies you track.
* **Weekly summaries**: Emails summarizing the biggest events from the past week from the companies
  and sectors you follow.
* **Real-time alerts**: For critical updates on high-priority companies.
* **Integrations**: Get real-time updates from the companies you follow directly in Slack or
  Microsoft Teams.

Can I use Distill to track my competitors' social media activity?

Yes. Distill specifically monitors **LinkedIn company posts**. Companies often share their fastest
updates on LinkedIn before a press release goes out, such as new hires, minor product updates, or
partnerships. Distill captures these and presents them alongside traditional news.

Does Distill offer a free trial?

Yes. Distill offers a [14-day free trial][7] so you can set up your watchlists, configure your
filters, and see the difference between a standard news feed and a curated intelligence feed. Just
add the companies you want to track, and you're up and running in minutes.

#### **Motivation**

We need new economic drivers for spaceflight. Something new and potentially bigger than any existing
space industry such as telecommunications, remote sensing, launch and research. This is the missing
piece to speed up development for the exciting Star Trek-like future. I believe in-space
manufacturing will be the kickstarter and foundation.

In-space manufacturing could be enabler and first customer for numerous asteroid mining, commercial
space station and utility companies in space. If asteroid mining will be a $1 trillion business then
in-space manufacturing will be a $10 trillion business thanks to all the materials made into
products with extra value.

Some more thoughts in my interview **[What excites you about in-space manufacturing?][107]** with
Filling Space. There is much more to say and especially do.

> If we can establish a Mars colony, we can almost certainly colonize the whole Solar System,
> because we'll have **created a strong economic forcing function for the improvement of space
> travel**. Once we have that forcing function, and an Earth-to-Mars economy, we'll cover the whole
> Solar System. But the key is that we have to make the Mars thing work. If we're going to have any
> chance of sending stuff to other star systems, we need to be laser-focused on becoming a
> multi-planet civilization. That's the next step.
> 
> Elon Musk interview with Ross Andersen, Aeon, 30 September 2014

> To those of us who feel that space manufacturing offers great potential for human benefit, such a
> delay seems nearly criminal, but on the time-scale of human existence a mere fifteen years is
> hardly the blink of an eye.
> 
> O'Neill, Gerard.The High Frontier: Human Colonies In Space

> Most important, in a practical sense, would be the construction of factories that could make use
> of the special properties of space — high and low temperatures, hard radiation. Unlimited vacuum,
> zero gravity — to manufacture objects that could be difficult or impossible to manufacture on
> Earth, so that the world's technology might be totally transformed. In fact, projects might even
> be on the planning boards in 2019 to shift industries into orbit in a wholesale manner.
> Space, you see, is far more voluminous than Earth's surface is and it is therefore a far more
> useful repository for the waste that is inseparable from industry. Nor are there living things in
> space to suffer from the influx of waste. And the waste would not even remain in Earth's vicinity,
> but would be swept outward far beyond the asteroid belt by the solar wind. Earth will then be in a
> position to rid itself of the side-effects of industrialization, and yet without actually getting
> rid of its needed advantages. The factories will be gone, but not far, only a few thousand miles
> straight up.
> 
> Isaac Asimov predictions for 2019 in 1983 in The Stare

#### **In-Space Manufacturing Commercial Microgravity Applications**

##### Destinations

*Earth*
  Make novel materials and products in microgravity and bring back to Earth for terrestrial markets.
*Space*
  Make large-space structures or new products in space for consumption or utilization in space.

##### Benefits

*Earth*
  Materials and products that can not be manufactured or are much better.
*Space*
  No requirement to survive launch loads.
  Size is not limited by the launcher fairing.
  Use in-situ space resources or recycle existing.

#### **Global Trends** Space manufacturing is coming. What are the supporting macro trends?
* Decreasing launch costs (10x-100x)
* Commercialization of space & LEO; NewSpace mindset
* Commercial transportation services, space stations etc
* ISRU, asteroid mining & space resources advances
* Pollution & climate change on Earth; emerging technologies
* Increasing momentum for space exploration and settlement

Introduction to in-space manufacturing, in-space economy and alternatively new space economy.

economy, cislunar economy, Moon & Mars economies and dozens more.

Overview of commercial microgravity applications. Both for terrestrial use and in-space use. Listing

microgravity.

Factories in Space is the largest public database of companies active in the emerging in-space

#### **Motivation**

We need new economic drivers for spaceflight. Something new and potentially bigger than any existing
space industry such as telecommunications, remote sensing, launch and research. This is the missing
piece to speed up development for the exciting Star Trek-like future. I believe in-space
manufacturing will be the kickstarter and foundation.

In-space manufacturing could be enabler and first customer for numerous asteroid mining, commercial
space station and utility companies in space. If asteroid mining will be a $1 trillion business then
in-space manufacturing will be a $10 trillion business thanks to all the materials made into
products with extra value.

Some more thoughts in my interview **[What excites you about in-space manufacturing?][107]** with
Filling Space. There is much more to say and especially do.

> If we can establish a Mars colony, we can almost certainly colonize the whole Solar System,
> because we'll have **created a strong economic forcing function for the improvement of space
> travel**. Once we have that forcing function, and an Earth-to-Mars economy, we'll cover the whole
> Solar System. But the key is that we have to make the Mars thing work. If we're going to have any
> chance of sending stuff to other star systems, we need to be laser-focused on becoming a
> multi-planet civilization. That's the next step.
> 
> Elon Musk interview with Ross Andersen, Aeon, 30 September 2014

> To those of us who feel that space manufacturing offers great potential for human benefit, such a
> delay seems nearly criminal, but on the time-scale of human existence a mere fifteen years is
> hardly the blink of an eye.
> 
> O'Neill, Gerard.The High Frontier: Human Colonies In Space

> Most important, in a practical sense, would be the construction of factories that could make use
> of the special properties of space — high and low temperatures, hard radiation. Unlimited vacuum,
> zero gravity — to manufacture objects that could be difficult or impossible to manufacture on
> Earth, so that the world's technology might be totally transformed. In fact, projects might even
> be on the planning boards in 2019 to shift industries into orbit in a wholesale manner.
> Space, you see, is far more voluminous than Earth's surface is and it is therefore a far more
> useful repository for the waste that is inseparable from industry. Nor are there living things in
> space to suffer from the influx of waste. And the waste would not even remain in Earth's vicinity,
> but would be swept outward far beyond the asteroid belt by the solar wind. Earth will then be in a
> position to rid itself of the side-effects of industrialization, and yet without actually getting
> rid of its needed advantages. The factories will be gone, but not far, only a few thousand miles
> straight up.
> 
> Isaac Asimov predictions for 2019 in 1983 in The Stare

#### **In-Space Manufacturing Commercial Microgravity Applications**

##### Destinations

*Earth*
  Make novel materials and products in microgravity and bring back to Earth for terrestrial markets.
*Space*
  Make large-space structures or new products in space for consumption or utilization in space.

##### Benefits

*Earth*
  Materials and products that can not be manufactured or are much better.
*Space*
  No requirement to survive launch loads.
  Size is not limited by the launcher fairing.
  Use in-situ space resources or recycle existing.

#### **Global Trends** Space manufacturing is coming. What are the supporting macro trends?
* Decreasing launch costs (10x-100x)
* Commercialization of space & LEO; NewSpace mindset
* Commercial transportation services, space stations etc
* ISRU, asteroid mining & space resources advances
* Pollution & climate change on Earth; emerging technologies
* Increasing momentum for space exploration and settlement

the Tianlian-2 06 satellite into its predetermined orbit using a Long March-3B carrier rocket from
the Xichang Satellite Launch Center. The launch mission was a complete success. This satellite will
primarily provide data relay and telemetry services for manned spacecraft such as spacecraft and

This mission marked the 658th flight of the Long March series of carrier rocket

### At 20:00 on July 23, 2026, a Long March 3B carrier rocket successfully launched the Tianlian-2
### 06 satellite into its predetermined orbit from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center. Despite
### being struck by lightning during the launch, the mission was still a complete success,
### attracting widespread attention.

### 
### Basic Launch Information : Launch Time : 20:00 Beijing Time, July 23, 2026 Launch Site : Xichang
### Satellite Launch Center Carrier Rocket : Long March 3B carrier rocket (Y118 batch) Orbital
### Status : Satellite successfully entered its predetermined orbit;

###  

### I. Basic Launch Information
* **Launch time** : 20:00 Beijing time on July 23, 2026
* **Launch site** : Xichang Satellite Launch Center
* **Launch vehicle** : Long March 3B launch vehicle (Y118 batch)
* **Orbital status** : The satellite successfully entered its predetermined orbit, and the launch
  mission was a complete success.
* **Mission number** : 658th flight of the Long March series carrier rocket, 50th launch of China’s
  space program in 2026.

**II. Satellite Overview**
* **Satellite Name** : Tianlian-2 06
* **Research and Development Unit** : China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), China Aerospace
  Science and Technology Corporation (CASC)
* **Satellite type** : China’s second-generation geostationary orbit data relay satellite
* **Main uses** :
  * Provide data relay and telemetry services for manned spacecraft such as spacecraft and space
    stations.

 Provide data relay and telemetry services for medium and low Earth orbit resource satellites.

 Provide telemetry, tracking and command support for spacecraft launches.

**III. Highlights of this launch**
* **Lightning strikes rocket** : The rocket was struck by lightning shortly after liftoff, with its
  exhaust plume and the lightning forming a clear conductive path. This is the first time a Long
  March series rocket has been visibly struck by lightning.
* ** Severe weather conditions during launch window** : Xichang experienced thunderstorms prior to
  launch, and the rocket lifted off in the rain and broke through the thunderstorm clouds.
* ** Photographer Captures Epic Moment** : Photographer “Black and White Cat’s Name Already Taken”
  captures the moment lightning strikes a rocket, claiming it’s his 61st time photographing rockets
  and he’s obtained an “epic” image.
* ** IV. Mission Background and Network Progress**
* **The Tianlian-2 satellite family** : Since the launch of Tianlian-2 01 in 2019, the development
  of Tianlian-2 02 and 03 satellites was completed in 3 years, and the development of 04 to 06

**On the 23 July 2026  launch** [ CNSA _China National Space Administration][23] **-China – People’s
Republic of China Hong Kong –Beijing Time China- People’s Republic of China**…. at the Xichang
Satellite Launch Center, Sichuan Province of the Xichang Launch Center Today, China successfully
launched Tianlian-2 06Satellite into space using the Long March 3B carrier rocket from the Xichang
Satellite Launch Center….. …..At 20:00 Beijing time on July 23, 2026, China successfully launched
the Tianlian-2 06 satellite into its predetermined orbit using a Long March-3B carrier rocket from
the Xichang Satellite Launch Center. The launch mission was a complete success. This satellite will
primarily provide data relay and telemetry services for manned spacecraft such as spacecraft and
space stations, as well as data relay and telemetry services for medium and low Earth orbit resource
satellites, and telemetry support for spacecraft launches.

This mission marked the 658th flight of the Long March series of carrier rocket

### At 20:00 on July 23, 2026, a Long March 3B carrier rocket successfully launched the Tianlian-2
### 06 satellite into its predetermined orbit from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center. Despite
### being struck by lightning during the launch, the mission was still a complete success,
### attracting widespread attention.

### 
### Basic Launch Information : Launch Time : 20:00 Beijing Time, July 23, 2026 Launch Site : Xichang
### Satellite Launch Center Carrier Rocket : Long March 3B carrier rocket (Y118 batch) Orbital
### Status : Satellite successfully entered its predetermined orbit;

###  

### I. Basic Launch Information
* **Launch time** : 20:00 Beijing time on July 23, 2026
* **Launch site** : Xichang Satellite Launch Center
* **Launch vehicle** : Long March 3B launch vehicle (Y118 batch)
* **Orbital status** : The satellite successfully entered its predetermined orbit, and the launch
  mission was a complete success.
* **Mission number** : 658th flight of the Long March series carrier rocket, 50th launch of China’s
  space program in 2026.

**II. Satellite Overview**
* **Satellite Name** : Tianlian-2 06
* **Research and Development Unit** : China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), China Aerospace
  Science and Technology Corporation (CASC)
* **Satellite type** : China’s second-generation geostationary orbit data relay satellite
* **Main uses** :
  * Provide data relay and telemetry services for manned spacecraft such as spacecraft and space
    stations.

 Provide data relay and telemetry services for medium and low Earth orbit resource satellites.

 Provide telemetry, tracking and command support for spacecraft launches.

**III. Highlights of this launch**
* **Lightning strikes rocket** : The rocket was struck by lightning shortly after liftoff, with its
  exhaust plume and the lightning forming a clear conductive path. This is the first time a Long
  March series rocket has been visibly struck by lightning.
* ** Severe weather conditions during launch window** : Xichang experienced thunderstorms prior to
  launch, and the rocket lifted off in the rain and broke through the thunderstorm clouds.
* ** Photographer Captures Epic Moment** : Photographer “Black and White Cat’s Name Already Taken”
  captures the moment lightning strikes a rocket, claiming it’s his 61st time photographing rockets
  and he’s obtained an “epic” image.
* ** IV. Mission Background and Network Progress**
* **The Tianlian-2 satellite family** : Since the launch of Tianlian-2 01 in 2019, the development
  of Tianlian-2 02 and 03 satellites was completed in 3 years, and the development of 04 to 06
  satellites was completed in 2 years, with the development cycle of a single satellite continuously
  shortening.
* **Network deployment complete** : All six Tianlian-2 satellites have been launched into orbit,
  further enhancing the coverage and service efficiency of the new generation space-based data relay
  network.14
* **Rocket reliability** : The Long March 3A series rockets have successfully launched Tianlian-2 01
  to 06 satellites consecutively since 2019. This mission was developed by the First Academy of
  China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation

downward, each new coil falls a shorter distance, naturally forming the familiar tapered swirl.

comfort.

interior layout. The tiny house includes a useful office area that doubles as a downstairs bedroom,

## Что под капотом — *коротко*.

Не «AI-magic». Конкретные технологии и конкретные источники данных. Без них прогноз ROI — гадание.

**Ансамбль ИИ-моделей** читает карточку WB/Ozon, считает воронку (CTR, CR, выкуп), сверяет с
категорийными бенчмарками и отдаёт прогноз ROI на 12 месяцев.

**MPStats Connect API** отдаёт нам факт-данные продаж 2 900+ SKU. **Evirma** — историю позиций и
CPM-аукциона. **WB internal API** — комиссии, тарифы, габариты. **1688 vision search** — поиск
фабрики по фото товара (TMAPI), 5 поставщиков с MOQ, ценой и доставкой авиа/ж.д.

Сверху — **ручная модерация** финансиста и тестера: каждый отчёт проходит человеческий gate перед
выдачей. Это и есть разница между «дашбордом» и «решением».

5 доверенных источника данных в одном отчёте
01MPStats Connect APIфакт-данные
02EvirmaCPM / позиции
03WB internal APIкомиссии
04TMAPI / 1688 visionпоставщики
05База 2 900 SKUбенчмарки

## Как мы держим *точность*.

Три слоя проверки — от сырых API до подписи финансиста. Поэтому отклонение прогноза от факта не
превышает 7%.

01 — сбор

### 5 источников вместо одного

MPStats + Evirma + WB API + 1688 vision + наша база 2 900 SKU. Каждая цифра в отчёте имеет провенанс
— мы знаем, откуда она пришла, и показываем источник в PDF.

02 — модель

### Ансамбль, а не один LLM

Прогноз ROI считают параллельно несколько моделей (категорийная регрессия + ML на 2 900 SKU +
LLM-валидатор). Расхождение > 15% → отчёт уходит на ручную проверку.

03 — модерация

### Человек закрывает gate

Финансист и тестер вычитывают P&L, юнит-эку и поставщиков. Без подписи модератора отчёт не уходит
клиенту. Это медленнее на 30 минут — и точнее на порядок.

Контрольная метрика Отклонение прогноза ROI *≤ 7%* на горизонте 12 мес.

Они отдают данные. Мы отдаём решение: купить — или пройти мимо.

# Skybrokers

## All-in-one reseller of new and used satellite equipment

Skybrokers is your trusted all-in-one reseller of new and used satellite equipment, serving
customers worldwide with complete and cost-effective solutions. As a true one-stop-shop, we supply
**antennas**, **RF-equipment**, **spare parts**, and **full ground station systems** for teleport,
broadcast, government, and enterprise markets. Our extensive global network for buying and selling
enables fast sourcing and reliable availability. Customers benefit from our fast response times,
dependable service, and competitive pricing to reduce CAPEX. From single components to complete
installations, Skybrokers delivers professional turnkey solutions tailored to your project needs.

## Projects around the globe

Since its inception, Skybrokers has successfully completed a wide range of antenna projects
worldwide, supporting customers across every region of the globe. From de-installation and
refurbishment to transportation, installation, and full commissioning, our experienced team has
delivered reliable solutions for teleport operators, broadcasters, governments, and satellite
service providers. Each completed project reflects our commitment to quality, technical expertise,
and dependable execution in the global satellite ground station industry.

## A trusted partner for your most critical missions

Reliable and resilient data and space services for enhanced situational awareness and smarter
decision-making in a changing world.

Spire’s government solutions provide mission-critical satellite data for security and defense
initiatives worldwide. Spire’s radio frequency geolocation solutions help agencies enhance security
and counter dark actors. Our APIs and customized datasets deliver precise aviation, weather, and
environmental insights for improved situational awareness. Strengthen global security operations
with Spire’s market-leading Earth, atmospheric, and aviation intelligence.

[Explore Government solutions][34]

Industry solutions

## How can Spire’s industry solutions work for you?

Our industry solutions provide actionable, space-powered data to anticipate challenges, solve
problems, and drive measurable results for your business.

Leverage proprietary satellite constellations, advanced atmospheric profiling, and global flight
intelligence to power smarter, data-driven operations. From hyper-accurate weather forecasting and
climate risk insights to real-time aircraft tracking and aviation analytics, Spire provides timely,
reliable, and actionable data. Organizations can use these insights to improve safety, optimize
performance, enhance operational efficiency, and build resilience in an ever-changing global
environment.

[Explore Industry solutions][35]

Industry solutions

## How can Spire work for you?

Our industry solutions provide space-powered data that anticipate and solve your toughest
challenges. Let us show you how our industry solutions can help enrich your business.
* [Weather & Climate][36]
* [Aviation][37]

### Weather & Climate

Unleash the power of cutting-edge satellite technology to enrich data on hundreds of environmental
factors. We enable the creation of custom predictive models for accurate Earth monitoring and
decision-making support. Our DeepVision™ dashboard combines detailed, near real-time weather and
environmental data from across the globe, utilizing both ground and satellite sources for
unparalleled insight.
[Explore Weather & Climate solutions][38]

### Aviation

Spire’s global ADS-B coverage unveils a world of real-time, accurate insights for your industry.
Discover next-generation space-based flight tracking data and aviation intelligence. Spire’s EURIALO
project will mitigate GPS jamming and create more efficient and safe flight patterns worldwide. Our
space-based aviation intelligence solutions give you precise insights to make critical operational
decisions. Supercharge your aviation intelligence

## The promise of space is here

Spire’s data and solutions inspire the boldness and hope to create a better here and now

## Featured data solution products



Aviation

### EURIALO: A new era in air traffic aviation surveillance

The next generation of aviation tracking from space is in development. We will increase global
security, minimize the aviation industry’s carbon footprint, and increase efficiency and location
accuracy.
[Explore EURIALO][41]

Space Services

### Spire’s Constellation Management Platform

Spire’s Constellation Management Platform (CMP) is a tool for streamlining satellite control for our
customers; automating operations, simplifying tasks and enabling direct communication with space
assets.
[Explore Constellation Management Platform][42]

Weather & Climate

### DeepVision™: An advanced weather visualization dashboard

Customize your DeepVision™ weather dashboard to swiftly adapt your logistics and transport network
to minimize weather-related disruptions in supply chain management.
[Explore DeepVision™][43]

### Elevate your business, and the world, from the ultimate vantage point – space

We produce custom datasets for your industry using unrivaled radio occultation technology. Every
minute we gather rich insights from every point on Earth – including the most remote regions of the
planet. We analyze and combined each datapoint with supplemental insights that enable data-driven
decisions across the enterprise through easy-to-use APIs. Enhance your industry solution through
efficiency, and fuel innovation faster than your competition.

If you could see the entire picture, predict imminent issues, and take action confidently — what
would you change?

[Explore our data solutions][44]

## About Spire

*

### Global insights

*
  **Unlock our data & solutions.** Spire collects rich and unique datasets that track oceans, skies,
  land and weather 24/7. Our data collection technique means we can see the ocean currents, winds,
  and soil moisture.
  
  [What we do][45]
*

### Elevated data

*
  **Building a space-powered, global data network.** Spire was formed by founders from three
  countries scattered across the globe, united by a common desire to build a better planet.
  
  [Our vision][46]
*

### Predictive analytics

*
  **Know more, change the future.** We know top-quality data – analyzed and enriched by savvy
  experts – will help build a better future. This is why we work with companies like [NVIDIA on the
  future of weather modelling and prediction][47].
  
  [Our mission][48]

Aviation

The next generation of aviation tracking from space is in development. We will increase global
security, minimize the aviation industry’s carbon footprint, and increase efficiency and location
accuracy.
[Explore EURIALO][41]

Space Services

### Spire’s Constellation Management Platform

Spire’s Constellation Management Platform (CMP) is a tool for streamlining satellite control for our
customers; automating operations, simplifying tasks and enabling direct communication with space
assets.
[Explore Constellation Management Platform][42]

Weather & Climate

### DeepVision™: An advanced weather visualization dashboard

Customize your DeepVision™ weather dashboard to swiftly adapt your logistics and transport network
to minimize weather-related disruptions in supply chain management.
[Explore DeepVision™][43]

### Elevate your business, and the world, from the ultimate vantage point – space

We produce custom datasets for your industry using unrivaled radio occultation technology. Every
minute we gather rich insights from every point on Earth – including the most remote regions of the
planet. We analyze and combined each datapoint with supplemental insights that enable data-driven
decisions across the enterprise through easy-to-use APIs. Enhance your industry solution through
efficiency, and fuel innovation faster than your competition.

If you could see the entire picture, predict imminent issues, and take action confidently — what
would you change?

[Explore our data solutions][44]

## About Spire

*

### Global insights

*
  **Unlock our data & solutions.** Spire collects rich and unique datasets that track oceans, skies,
  land and weather 24/7. Our data collection technique means we can see the ocean currents, winds,
  and soil moisture.
  
  [What we do][45]
*

### Elevated data

*
  **Building a space-powered, global data network.** Spire was formed by founders from three
  countries scattered across the globe, united by a common desire to build a better planet.
  
  [Our vision][46]
*

### Predictive analytics

*
  **Know more, change the future.** We know top-quality data – analyzed and enriched by savvy
  experts – will help build a better future. This is why we work with companies like [NVIDIA on the
  future of weather modelling and prediction][47].
  
  [Our mission][48]

modern phones, tablets, and some laptops support eSIM technology.

or easy digital management. Here's why you might choose an eSIM:
* **Easier Switching Between Carriers:**With an eSIM, you can switch carriers easily without a
  physical SIM card.

* **No Physical Card to Lose or Damage:**An eSIM is built into your phone, so it can't be lost or
  damaged like a traditional SIM card.
* **Environmentally Friendly:** eSIMs reduce waste and environmental impact by eliminating physical

## More about Tunz

### What is eSIM?

An eSIM, or "embedded SIM," is a digital version of the traditional SIM card built directly into the
device. This lets you to change phone numbers or switch carriers without inserting or swapping
physical SIM cards.

‍

With an eSIM, you can easily activate new mobile plans, add data, or switch providers digitally.
This feature is incredibly convenient for travelers seeking local or international data plans. Many
modern phones, tablets, and some laptops support eSIM technology.

### Why use eSIM?

An eSIM provides convenience, especially for travelers and those wanting flexibility in mobile plans
or easy digital management. Here's why you might choose an eSIM:
* **Easier Switching Between Carriers:**With an eSIM, you can switch carriers easily without a
  physical SIM card.
* **Perfect for Travelers:**An eSIM lets you quickly download data plans, avoiding roaming fees and
  needing a local SIM. Just scan a QR code to connect.
* **Dual SIM Convenience:**eSIM-compatible phones allow you to keep your primary number on a
  physical SIM and add a secondary line, useful for work and travel.
* **No Physical Card to Lose or Damage:**An eSIM is built into your phone, so it can't be lost or
  damaged like a traditional SIM card.
* **Environmentally Friendly:** eSIMs reduce waste and environmental impact by eliminating physical
  SIM cards.

### How long does the integration take to complete?

Integrating Tunz eSIM into an app or website is a quick and straightforward process. The duration
largely depends on your team's focus and priorities. Typically, the integration can be completed
within a few weeks, but if given full priority, it can be achieved in as little as five days.

Tunz offers a user-friendly API for developers and direct communication channels that provide the
necessary support to ensure smooth operation.

### What devices are compatible with eSIM?

Tunz eSIM works on many modern smartphones and tablets,  but compatibility can depend on where you
bought the device. Some countries or carriers restrict eSIM features. Here are some popular
eSIM-compatible devices:
* Apple: iPhone models from iPhone XS and newer.
* Samsung: Galaxy models like the S20, S21, and newer.
* Google: Pixel models starting from Pixel 3 and newer.

For the best results, verify eSIM support with your carrier or the device specifications.

### How can I integrate Tunz eSIM into my business?

Integrating the Tunz eSIM into your business is straightforward. It lets you offer digital mobile
data plans for +150 countries directly through your app or website. Here's how it works:
* **1. Create an account**
  Create a free account on Tunz Gigastore, our reselling platform. There is no need to pay a
  subscription or management fee. Feel free to reach out to our experts to discuss your business
  needs and to get extra perks.
  ‍
* **2. Connect to Tunz**
  Tunz provides an easy-to-use API to let developers add Tunz eSIM services to your app or site.
  ‍
* **3. Customize inventory**
  You can customize your eSIM offering to suit your business and customers by selecting various
  options for country coverage, validity, and data volume.
  ‍
* **4. Launch and Manage
  ‍**Once integrated, you can provide Tunz eSIM to your customers, allowing them to easily purchase
  mobile data plans and manage your inventory to enhance your conversion rate.

The process is quick, with support available to ensure smooth integration.

### Which countries are supported by Tunz eSIM?

Tunz eSIM supports over 150 countries worldwide, including popular regions across North America,
Europe, Asia, and parts of Africa. Some of the most popular countries are:
* United States and Canada in North America
* United Kingdom, Germany, France, and Spain in Europe
* Japan, South Korea, and Singapore in Asia
* South Africa in Africa

This coverage means that travelers and businesses can easily connect to mobile data in many regions,
but it’s always good to check Tunz latest list, as we are constantly expanding our coverage.

[Show more][49]

### How can I install Tunz eSIM on my mobile device?

Mobile apps that integrate Tunz eSIM enable a straightforward installation process, allowing users
to install the eSIM with just a tap of a button.

‍

For websites, Tunz eSIM provides a QR code that users can scan with their eSIM-capable devices to
access the purchased mobile data.

### How much does Tunz eSIM data cost?

Integrating Tunz eSIM into a new or existing product comes at no cost. You only pay for the data
packages that your customers purchase.

Tunz provides flexible, pay-as-you-go plans, ensuring you and your customers only pay for the data
you need. The cost of the eSIM data varies based on factors such as validity, coverage, and data
volume.

To explore our extensive selection of over 2,000 data offers, please request the pricing list or
sign up on Gigastore.

### How can I purchase data packages for my customers?

Purchasing data packages for your customers on the Tunz Gigastore is simple. Here's how you can do
it:
* **Sign Up for Tunz Gigastore**: First, create an account on the Tunz Gigastore platform if you
  don't have one already. This is where you can manage your purchases and data plans.
  ‍
* **Configure your inventory**: Upon logging in, you can explore and filter the available data
  offers to find the best plans for your customers. Remember to apply changes after selecting the
  packages to make them available in your eSIM shop. Charges apply only when you activate a data
  package, so ensure you have enough credits to cover the costs.
  ‍
* **Add credits**: Top up your Gigastore account with credits to activate data packages in
  real-time, so you won't need to pre-purchase. You can also enable Auto Top-Up to maintain balance
  and ensure customers receive mobile data packages.

It's a straightforward process with no hidden fees, making it easy for resellers to provide Tunz
eSIM plans to their customers.

### Is Tunz tied to any specific mobile connectivity provider?

No, Tunz is not tied to any specific mobile connectivity provider. It works with various networks
globally, allowing users to choose data plans from multiple providers without being locked to one
carrier.

You can use the Tunz eSIM on your device, select from different data plans, and connect to networks
based on your location.

This offers great flexibility, especially for travelers and businesses needing global coverage.

space exploration. The report, [The Next Frontier: Public Attitudes Towards Space and the Space

technology is. But what if that’s the wrong way to look for signs of an alien intelligence? What if
a resource-conscious civilization decided it was too complicated to send femto-second lasers in high
energy bursts out across the universe. A new paper, available in pre-print on arXiv, from
researchers Dániel Apai, Chia-Lung Lin, and Kevin Wagner, suggest that might actually be what
happens, and that we should start looking for long-duration pulsing interstellar beacons.
